item.title: Two lotteries, and the space between them
item.author: amir.g@ucf.edu (Amir Ghazizadeh)
item.description: Machine learning made two lottery arguments seven years apart and never put them in the same room. One says most of a trained network is surplus. The other says the hardware of the day decides whether you can collect on it.
